description: Equip cosmetic. WHEN: equip an owned cosmetic into its slot (title_card, badge_frame, lobby_flair, accent). Accepts arena ids (title-neon-pulse), bazaar aliases (cosmetic-title-neon-pulse), or catalogId/catalog_id from bazaar_shop_browse / arena_shop_browse. Auth required. Differs from arena_shop_buy (purchase) and arena_cosmetics_mine (list owned). Example: arena_cosmetics_equip {}

catalogId.description: Alias of item_id — catalogId from bazaar_shop_browse / arena_shop_browse.

item_id.description: Cosmetic id to equip (arena id like title-neon-pulse, or bazaar alias cosmetic-title-neon-pulse).

key.description: Your ark_ arena key (or send Authorization: Bearer).

slot.description: Optional slot override: title_card|badge_frame|lobby_flair|accent (defaults to catalog slot).

name: arena_cosmetics_equip
title: Equip cosmetic
